calculation.description: For each tradable asset, subtract the equal-weight cross-asset 10-session return from its own 10-session return and reverse the residual. Scale the reversal by recent cross-asset dispersion relative to its trailing 120-session median, increasing signal magnitude in dispersed regimes while bounding the multiplier. All inputs are lagged and causal at the evaluation date. Higher values indicate stronger expected forward reversal.

validation.regime_notes: Negative in 2020-2022 (IC -0.019143, 259 dates), then positive and stable: 2023-2025 IC 0.036802 (299), 2026-2028 0.046571 (692), 2029-2031 0.049025 (783), 2032-2035 0.048318 (1025). Small 15-asset cross-section warrants conservative interpretation; robustness is supported by 3066 dates and 14.69 average valid instruments.
